submissions.heading: Submissions
submissions.submitHelp: The client contacts you choose will receive the candidate's profile by email, with the resume attached.
submissions.noContacts: This client has no contacts yet. Add a contact on the client page first.
submissions.confirmWithdraw: Withdraw this candidate from the job? Scheduled interviews will be cancelled.

interviews.heading: Interviews
interviews.sendInvite: Email the invite to the candidate and the client
interviews.confirmCancel: Cancel this interview? A cancellation email goes out if the invite was sent.

feedback.heading: Client feedback
feedback.help: Enter what the client told you by email. The submission status follows the decision.
feedback.commentsHint: Paste the relevant part of the client's reply.

placements.heading: Offer and joining
placements.action_notJoined: Record that the candidate did not join
placements.joinedHelp: Use the day the candidate actually joined. Attach the joining email next; invoicing is blocked until it is attached.
placements.proofRule: The invoice can only be raised after the joining email is attached.
placements.proofHint: Accepted files: PDF, EML, MSG, PNG or JPG, up to 10 MB.
placements.sendCandidateEmail: Email the candidate to congratulate them and ask them to confirm
placements.candidateEmailHelp: The candidate replies to this email to confirm. Replies come to the person who sent it. When they confirm, click Offer accepted.

invoices.heading: Invoice
invoices.readyToRaise: The candidate has joined and the joining email is attached. The invoice is dated the joining day.
invoices.blockedNoProof: Attach the joining email above to raise the invoice.
invoices.noContacts: This client has no contact with an email address. Type a recipient below.
invoices.invalidRecipient: One of the recipient addresses is not valid.
invoices.cancelHelp: A cancelled invoice keeps its number and cannot be used again. You can raise a new invoice for the same joining afterwards.
invoices.tdsDeductedHint: Tax the client deducted. It counts towards the invoice but is not money received.

company.heading: Company settings
company.help: These details are printed on every invoice. Past invoices keep the details they were raised with.
company.emailHint: Clients reply to this address when they get an invoice.
company.stateHint: Used to decide between CGST and SGST, or IGST. Spell it the same way as on the client.
company.invoicePrefixHint: Numbers look like ABC/2026-27/0001 and restart each April.
company.sacCodeHint: 998512 is for recruitment and placement services.

replacements.heading: Exit and replacement
replacements.noExit: No exit recorded. Record one if the candidate has left the client.
replacements.notEligibleHelp: The candidate left after the free replacement period, so no free replacement is due.
replacements.openHelp: The candidate left inside the free period. Link the replacement once the new candidate has an offer for this job. No fee is charged for the replacement.
replacements.linkHelp: Choose from the offers made for the same job and client.
replacements.noOptions: There are no other offers on this job yet. Submit another candidate and record an offer first.
replacements.closeHelp: For example, the client decided not to replace.
replacements.noInvoice: No invoice is raised for this joining.

commissions.heading: Recruiter commission
commissions.help: A commission is paid after the replacement period ends and the client has paid the invoice in full. If the candidate leaves inside the period, it is cancelled.

recruiters.hint: Counts submissions made in the selected period. Joined is how many of those candidates have joined.

funnel.heading: Hiring funnel
funnel.hint: Follows the candidates submitted in the selected period through each stage.
funnel.averageDays: Average time from submission to joining

replacements.hint: Joinings and exits in the selected period. Exit rate is exits divided by joinings.

today.heading: Today
today.offDayHint: Today is not a working day, so checking in is optional.

month.heading: This month
month.pickHint: Select a past day to request a correction.

correction.heading: Request a correction
correction.help: Forgot to check in, or the time is wrong? Send the right times and HR will review them.

rules.heading: Attendance rules
rules.help: These rules decide late marks and whether a day counts as full, half or absent.
rules.graceHint: Check-ins after shift start plus this grace are marked late.
rules.halfDayHint: Worked time at or above this counts as a half day.
rules.fullDayHint: Worked time at or above this counts as a full day. Less than half day counts as absent.
rules.optionalQuotaHint: How many optional holidays each person can claim in a year.
rules.compOffValidHint: A comp off earned by working on an off day expires after this many days.

holidays.heading: Holidays
holidays.name: Holiday name
holidays.help: National holidays are paid days off for everyone. Optional holidays can be claimed by staff up to their yearly quota.

leave.heading: Leave and holidays
leave.noHolidays: No upcoming holidays have been added yet.
leave.compOffHelp: You earn a comp off by working on a weekly off or national holiday. Leave needs approval from your manager.

leaveTeam.grantHelp: Use this when someone worked on an off day without checking in. Below are all leave requests.

leaveApprovals.heading: Leave approvals
leaveApprovals.help: Leave applications, optional holiday and comp off requests waiting for a decision. You cannot decide your own request.

apply.title: Apply for leave
apply.help: Pick a leave type and dates. Weekly offs and national holidays are not counted. Your manager approves it.
apply.previewLeft: You have {n} day(s) left in this type.
apply.previewUnpaid: These days will not be paid.
apply.previewShort: Not enough balance. Choose Loss of pay for the rest.

types.help: Leave types your staff can apply for. Yearly days are credited every January and do not carry forward. Loss of pay has no balance and is not paid.
types.dialogHelp: Changes to yearly days apply to everyone straight away.
types.name: Name
types.yearlyHint: Half days are allowed, for example 7.5.
types.unpaidLabel: Unpaid leave (loss of pay, no balance)

holidayCalendar.heading: Holiday calendar
holidayCalendar.none: No holidays have been added for this year yet.

run.finalizeConfirm: Finalize payroll for {month}? It is locked afterwards, commissions in it are marked paid and employees can see their payslips.
run.notCalculated: Payroll has not been calculated for this month yet.
run.draftHelp: This is a draft. It uses attendance and leave up to now, so recalculate before finalizing. A month can be finalized once it is over.

adjust.title: Adjust payslip of {name}
adjust.help: Add a bonus or enter TDS and other deductions. Recalculating keeps these values.

structures.help: Enter the yearly CTC and the variable share. Basic, HRA and special allowance are worked out for you using the Rules tab, after setting aside employer PF and gratuity. Revising adds a new entry from the date you choose, older months keep their earlier amounts.
structures.dialogHelp: Everything below is calculated from the CTC.
structures.variableHint: Not paid monthly. Add it as Bonus on the payslip when it is approved.
structures.breakdownHelp: Employer PF and gratuity are part of CTC but are not paid in the monthly salary.

rules.help: Statutory deductions used when payroll is calculated. Provident fund is taken on basic pay, with the same ceiling for employee and employer.
rules.ctcHelp: Used to turn the fixed part of CTC into monthly pay. Changing these affects structures saved from now on, existing ones are not rewritten until they are revised.

payslip.title: Payslip for {month}
payslip.dialogHelp: Use Download PDF and choose Save as PDF in the print window.
payslip.generated: This is a computer generated payslip.

system.heading: System health
system.help: The server checks itself every few minutes. Admins get a notification and an email when something starts failing and again when it recovers. This page refreshes every 30 seconds.
